LADDER REFERENCE BUILT, LADDER NOT ARMED. Rolling 30d highs (Coinbase daily candles): BTC $82,283, ETH $2,567, SOL $110.65 -> rungs -12/-18/-25%: BTC 72,409 / 67,472 / 61,712; ETH 2,258.96 / 2,104.94 / 1,925.25; SOL 97.37 / 90.73 / 82.99. Stored in sleeve.ladder_reference. NOT ARMED for three reasons, in order of weight. (1) STRUCTURAL, and the operator must rule on it: charter law 1 / build item B16 require every resting buy rung to be hand-paired with a stop_limit at placement, and that is mechanically IMPOSSIBLE on Robinhood spot - a stop_limit SELL requires quantity you already hold, so a rung cannot be paired until a session wakes after it fills. Every unattended rung is therefore an unpaired rung; placing one tonight would break law 1 as written. (2) Arming input says no anyway: the macro driver is UNRESOLVED (US inflation print imminent, 9/16 FOMC hike risk) - the charter's own read law calls an ongoing macro driver FIRST-LEG, not terminal, and a rung that fills into it is exactly the knife the ledger says not to catch. (3) No capitulation conditioning: F&G 66 Greed, funding positive, short liqs dominant, BTC only -3.9% off its 30d high. Regime line ($59-61k June-2026 low) is clear at $79.0k - note the BTC -25% rung ($61,712) sits ON that line, so a fill there is simultaneously a scale-DOWN signal, which is a second argument against resting it unattended.
